title: Bóng hình
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"): F minor at 56 bpm. Its tune stays, hovering on C (C-Db-C), while the bass under it slides down by half steps (F-E-Eb-D: Fm, Fm(maj7)/E, Fm7/Eb, Fm6/D), a shape that stays as everything moves; then D-flat and the Neapolitan G-flat, a film's colour, before C7. The middle, in A-flat, does the same an octave up (Ab, Abmaj7/G, Ab7/Gb, Db/F) with the strings and the piano's rolled chords. The arc: the piano and the violas' thin line, a shadow; the cellos' slow second line joining; the middle; the piano with the cellos answering where the tune holds; the hovering C once more over the violas. An original tune.
